description: This file contains unit tests for the DeepLinkParser component of the OpenClaw project, verifying parsing logic for deep link URLs related to agent and gateway configurations.

classes.name: DeepLinkParserTests
classes.description: Test suite for parsing deep links, verifying correct handling of various URL formats and parameter edge cases.

methods.name: parseRejectsUnknownHost
methods.description: Tests that URLs with unknown host schemes are correctly rejected.

methods.name: parseHostIsCaseInsensitive
methods.description: Verifies that the host component in URLs is case-insensitive.

methods.name: parseRejectsNonOpenClawScheme
methods.description: Ensures URLs not using the 'openclaw' scheme are rejected.

methods.name: parseRejectsEmptyMessage
methods.description: Checks that empty message parameters result in rejection.

methods.name: parseAgentLinkParsesCommonFields
methods.description: Verifies parsing of common agent fields like message, deliver, sessionKey, etc.

methods.name: parseAgentLinkParsesTargetRoutingFields
methods.description: Checks parsing of target-specific routing fields like to, channel, key.

methods.name: parseRejectsNegativeTimeoutSeconds
methods.description: Ensures negative timeoutSeconds values result in default or rejection.

methods.name: parseGatewayLinkParsesCommonFields
methods.description: Verifies parsing of gateway URL fields like host, port, tls, token, password.

methods.name: parseGatewayLinkRejectsInsecureNonLoopbackWs
methods.description: Checks that insecure (non-HTTPS) WebSocket URLs targeting non-loopback addresses are rejected.

methods.name: parseGatewayLinkRejectsInsecurePrefixBypassHost
methods.description: Verifies that URLs with insecure hosts bypassing address checks are rejected.

methods.name: parseGatewaySetupCodeParsesBase64UrlPayload
methods.description: Tests decoding of setup code payloads from base64 URL encoding into gateway configuration.

methods.name: parseGatewaySetupCodeRejectsInvalidInput
methods.description: Verifies that invalid setup code strings are rejected.

methods.name: parseGatewaySetupCodeDefaultsTo443ForWssWithoutPort
methods.description: Checks that default port 443 is used when WSS URL lacks explicit port.

methods.name: parseGatewaySetupCodeRejectsInsecureNonLoopbackWs
methods.description: Ensures insecure WebSocket URLs to non-loopback hosts are rejected in setup code.

methods.name: parseGatewaySetupCodeRejectsInsecurePrefixBypassHost
methods.description: Verifies rejection of setup codes with insecure hosts bypassing address checks.

methods.name: parseGatewaySetupCodeAllowsLoopbackWs
methods.description: Accepts WebSocket URLs targeting loopback addresses, even if insecure.
